items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I got a good man in Ben's place, in Tab Smith.

ctx.x: But the money began to run out, and without the cooperation of MCA, the booking office, to book us in decent jobs and keep it going, the band began falling apart, and this way, the person -- when Ben left, Duke got Ben, and I got a good man in Ben's place, in Tab Smith. Now Tab was a great alto player who switched to tenor.
Oh yes, I know Tab. He was with Chick
